chunks: Muhammad ibn 'Ali ibn Mahbub narrated from Salamah ibn al-Khattab, from 'Ali ibn Sayf ibn 'Amirah, from 'Amr ibn Shimr, from Jabir, from Abu Ja'far عليه السلام, who said:
Whoever points with an iron weapon in a city, his hand is cut off; and whoever strikes therein is killed.

key_terms.بِحَدِيدَةٍ: with an iron weapon or sharp metal instrument
key_terms.قُطِعَتْ يَدُهُ: his hand is cut off as punishment
key_terms.مِصْرٍ: a city or settled urban area

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on threatening or attacking someone with an iron weapon in a city according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith conveys a legal ruling concerning the grave offense of threatening or attacking people with an iron weapon in a populated city. It reflects the severe punishment attached to acts that endanger public safety and spread فساد in society.
